The '''Vanqor listening station''' was a [[listening post]] operated by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[planet]] [[Vanqor]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Towards the end of the war, the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] decided to launch an [[Destruction of the Vanqor listening station|attack]] on the [[listening post]]. However, the [[Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos]], a secret Separatist mole working for [[Count]] [[Dooku]], warned the Separatists about the planned attack. As a result, Dooku was able to evacuate the listening post before [[Jedi]] and [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic|forces]] arrived.<ref name="Dark Disciple" />
